- 14:15–15:00 deep dive: suggested lead is Mateo Alvarez (Platform & Ops). Mateo, can you confirm availability and whether you want 30 vs 45?
- Preread bundle: I created a Drive folder and dropped a starter pack (SLA summary, tech primer, speaker bios). Link below. We’ll lock prereads after signoff from Veridian legal — aiming for Aug 18 publish.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB3x-VERIDIAN-PREREAD

Attachments: veridian-workshop-agenda-v1.pdf (agenda with lanes), travel-lanes.csv (arrival windows per speaker)

Next step: Mateo to confirm deep-dive ownership and Marissa to triage speaker pre-reads. If we have signoff by EOD Thu (Aug 13), we can publish Aug 18 as requested.

Looping in my edits — I pulled the agenda into a tracking sheet and added speaker commitments. Highlights: 

- I moved the 11:00 panel to 11:15 to create a 10-minute buffer for AV handoff.
- For the 14:15 deep dive, I recommend a 40-minute slot with 10 minutes for live Q and a 5-minute bridge to the next session so we avoid overruns.
- Added a dedicated slide set template for exec speakers (2–4 slides + 1 slide for call-to-action).

I've attached the speaker commitments spreadsheet (speaker-commitments.xlsx). Please check your names and travel arrival windows — I reconciled with the travel spreadsheet but flag any mismatches.

Also: we should lock the preread doc set by Aug 18 but please advise if any speaker needs extra time (we can move publish to Aug 19 at latest).
